model_optimizer: Same byte-identical v2 program, model, Adam AMSGrad and rate schedule; only training episode cap changes from 200 to 500.

learning_rate_schedule.formula: factor=0.1**clip((batch_start_steps-30000)/50000,0,1); apply to both initial rates at each batch start

gate: Report every seed and stability; require all three to meet both criteria for this candidate to clear the conservative production learning gate.
rationale: v2 all three pass cap200 but only one passes cap500. Test training on the longer evaluated horizon. This does not isolate horizon mismatch as the cause and is not a validated remedy.
development_disclosure: Third development protocol on the same seeds, chosen after inspecting v1 and v2. These seeds and evaluation streams are reused; not independent confirmation.
resource_gate: Measure v3 actual cost; production requires learning gate, realistic multi-thread timing pilot, allocation and partition checks.
bounded_revision: Only this three-seed validation is submitted. If unsuccessful, report before further development; no automatic sequence of searches.
implementation_evidence: Byte-identical source already passed v2 1/48-thread smoke and all three full-run technical validations. Existing CLI limit config is changed; no new program implementation to smoke.
timing_comparability: Training cap alters episode lengths, full-episode returns, batching and update counts; comparison across protocol versions is not a controlled timing result.
